  FROM DISK = 'D:\Backups\Sales_Full.bak'
  WITH MOVE 'Sales' TO 'E:\Data\Sales_Staging.mdf',
       MOVE 'Sales_log' TO 'F:\Log\Sales_Staging.ldf';
